title: New Track: Thom Quentin Leigh
content: Into our inbox last week came this little treat from unsigned Bristol artist Thom Quentin Leigh, “The Last of You”. Why do we like it? Well, it sounds like he’s singing “Nick Knowles…is in my blood”, and we’re big fans of DIY SOS.
